cohort: 83 neonates receiving therapeutic hypothermia for perinatal asphyxia
finding: Severe outcome (death or major neurological sequelae at one year of age) was significantly associated with lower pH, lower Apgar score, higher Sarnat score, and Cesarean section delivery.
mod_finding: Cesarean section delivery was significantly associated with severe outcome in neonates treated with therapeutic hypothermia for perinatal asphyxia.
